verification_level: FAST plus BATCH plus the targeted allocator-hook negative control and the phase-11 X.509 court suite (including RT-X509-REQ, RT-X509-ACERT and RT-X509-V3). Eight files audited, one genuine soundness defect found and repaired (M84-D1: X509_ocspid_print did not test its DER allocation for NULL), no ABI/layout regression, no new hidden obligation.
scope: Per-file contract audit of the head entries of REMAINING-AUDIT.txt: the request, certificate and OCSP printers; the allowed-attributes and authority-attribute ASN.1 item groups; the auditIdentity row; and the basic-constraints and basic-attribute-constraints item groups plus their v2i/i2v callbacks.

defects.class: missing allocation-failure check feeding a NULL buffer to EVP_Digest (undefined behaviour from a compliant C caller; authority returns 0)
defects.authority: crypto/x509/t_x509.c:224: if ((der = dertmp = OPENSSL_malloc(derlen)) == NULL) goto err;
defects.description: X509_ocspid_print replaced the authority's checked OPENSSL_malloc with OwnedDerBuf::malloc but did not test the None answer. With a failed allocation, dptr/dertmp stayed NULL, i2d_X509_NAME(subj, &NULL) returned the required length without writing, and EVP_Digest(NULL, derlen, ...) read a NULL buffer. This was both a soundness defect (OOM-reachable NULL dereference) and a compatibility divergence from the authority's 0 answer.
defects.repair: Take the err: tail (ocspid_err) when the owner is absent: `if der.is_none() { return ocspid_err(der, md); }`. The CRYPTO_malloc coordinate (:224) and the success/err free coordinates (:238/:264) are unchanged; no unsafe operation was added or removed.

test_only_unsafe_operations: src/x509/t_x509.rs alloc_probe: hook_malloc/hook_realloc/hook_free are three `unsafe extern "C"` functions used only by the env-gated negative control. Each call is sourced by its hook's contract (malloc/realloc have no preconditions; free receives NULL or a block from hook_malloc). The module is #[cfg(test)] and absent from the release configuration.
boundary_control: The targeted control installs the CRYPTO_set_mem_functions seam with a one-shot hook that answers NULL only for the block requested at file `crypto/x509/t_x509.c`, line 224, then calls X509_ocspid_print on a blank certificate. It asserted the seam accepted the hooks (installed == 1), the call answered 0, and the hook actually fired; the failure-state allocation was allowed through to avoid recursion.
not_discharged: All audited files are file-level audits, not SAFETY_DISCHARGED and not SAFE_COMPATIBLE.
Miri/ASan/Loom/TSan were not run: no owner, extent, aliasing or concurrency mechanism changed. The repaired path is allocation-failure-only and is exercised by the targeted allocator control.
FRF and the SEAL-level forensic regeneration were not run.
retained_obligations: src/x509/t_req.rs: bp is a live BIO and x a live X509_REQ; every extension-stack element is a live X509_EXTENSION; the stack returned by X509_REQ_get_extensions is this call's to free, and the authority-faithful print-failure leak is recorded as M84-R1.

src/x509/t_x509.rs: bp/out is a live BIO and x is a live X509 (or NULL where the contract says so); OwnedDerBuf owns exactly the CRYPTO_malloc block it allocated and releases it once at the site named by self.line; OwnedStr::adopt receives only the block X509_VERIFY_PARAM_get1_ip_asc returned; every stack element is a live object of its tag.

src/x509/v3_aaa.rs: method/out are the caller's; the choice selector selects the live union arm; aai->attributes is a live SET OF choice stack and aai->holderDomain is its live mandatory GENERAL_NAME.
src/x509/v3_authattid.rs: aids is a live STACK_OF(OSSL_ISSUER_SERIAL); iss->issuer is a live GENERAL_NAMES and iss->issuerUID a live bit string; method/out are the caller's.

src/x509/v3_bcons.rs and src/x509/v3_battcons.rs: values is a live STACK_OF(CONF_VALUE) whose elements carry NUL-terminated names; the v2i-created item is owned by this call until returned or freed on every failure arm.

src/x509/v3_akeya.rs, src/x509/v3_audit_id.rs and the item groups in the other audited v3 files: a is NULL or a value built by the named item layer; d2i's slot/cursor/len and i2d's value/cursor satisfy the shared ASN.1 item contract.

src/x509/v3_audit_id.rs: the two const-fn transmutes are the authority's own row casts between ABI-compatible pointer-parameter function types; no ownership crosses the table and both callees ignore method/ctx.
secret_bearing_buffers: No new secret-bearing buffer or cleansing claim changed. The audited printers handle public certificate/request data; X509_ocspid_print hashes public names and public keys. The DER scratch block is public and is plainly freed at the authority coordinates.
residuals: M84-R1 (low, authority parity): X509_REQ_print_ex returns without releasing the X509_REQ_get_extensions stack when a printer fails; t_req.c's err: label does not free it either. Liveness only, never UB, left faithful.
M84-R2 (info, test-only): the allocator-hook control is process-global and must run alone (env X509_OCSPID_ALLOC_PROBE=1), following the existing sparse-array probe convention.
